name: Ne nado snov
source:
A year has passed since Semyon woke up from the mysterious dream about the pioneer camp "Sovyonok" - a strange, vibrant place that became a breath of freedom and hope amidst a dreary reality. But the memory of it has not faded. It lives on in him... and in the one he brought back from there.

Now they are together. In an old apartment, amidst the everyday routine narrowed down to work, studies, and a lack of sleep, they drift side by side, like two lost universes that have found each other. A winter evening, a mundane dinner, conversations about dreams, fears, and the past.

Their home is warm. Because she is in it. And so is he.
And even if the rest of the world feels like a dream, they know for sure: this is reality.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3574204256]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗从关于“索维诺克”拓荒者营地的神秘梦境中醒来已经过去了一年——一个陌生而充满活力的地方，在沉闷的现实中变成了自由和希望的气息。但它的记忆并没有消失。它依然存在于他的内心……以及他从那里带回来的那个人身上。

现在他们在一起了。在一间旧公寓里，在工作、学习和睡眠不足的日常生活中，他们并肩漂流，就像两个失落的宇宙找到了彼此。一个冬天的夜晚，一顿平凡的晚餐，谈论梦想、恐惧和过去。

他们的家很温暖。因为她就在其中。他也是。
即使世界其他地方感觉像一场梦，他们也确信：这就是现实。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3574204256]Steam[/url]]
